evidence.description: Report 24-068202 states the incident date as Friday, March 22, 2024, with time not reported, at a residence in the 5300 block of East 29th Street, Long Beach, CA. Officers were dispatched and met the reporting party.

The narrative and OTHER field describe a suspect who posed as a salesman or service worker, knocked, and entered when the occupants did not appear to be home. The report says police state this for every incident in the series and it is not specific to this address, so it is not recorded as this incident's entry method.
